title: ctlv: Prepare message input handling
overview: Introduces the drivers/ctlv core module skeleton (Kconfig, Makefile, MAINTAINERS) and the input side of message handling: bounds-checked walking of TLV nests, a per-request index of attrs, and validated accessors. Generated family readers use the CTLV_IN_* macros in include/linux/ctlv_family.h, which call exported functions in message.c; message.h and internal.h are private to the core. CONFIG_CTLV is not yet wired into drivers/Kconfig or drivers/Makefile.

files.purpose: Adds the new driver directory to the CTLV maintainer entry.

units.title: Add drivers/ctlv/ to CTLV entry
units.summary: The core's source directory is now covered by the CTLV maintainers.

files.purpose: Defines the tristate CTLV option for the core module; not yet sourced from drivers/Kconfig.

units.title: menuconfig CTLV
units.summary: Tristate option describing what the core owns (device lifetime, TLV format, validation, replies, events, introspection).

files.purpose: Builds the core as a single ctlv.o module from its object files.

units.title: ctlv.o composite
units.summary: Builds ctlv.ko from message.o; later patches add more objects to ctlv-y.

files.purpose: Core-private types shared among the core's .c files: per-op entries, error state, and the per-operation context. Not visible to families.

units.title: Header, includes and constants
units.summary: Includes the family and message headers and defines the error message size and the 'no availability state' sentinel.

units.title: struct ctlv_op_entry
units.summary: Per-device runtime view of one op: its schema, the family's binding, private data, sizes, availability state index and absent flag.

units.title: struct ctlv_error
units.summary: Structured error detail (reason, message, offending attr and nest offsets, missing attr id, generations) collected for the reply.

units.title: struct ctlv_query_fragment
units.summary: State for fragmented query replies: generation, cursor positions, progress and result.

units.title: struct ctlv_op_ctx
units.summary: Everything for one operation invocation: family, op entry, request and output messages with root cursors, the deepest output cursor, fragment and error state.
units.details: The request ctlv_msg's `ctx` back-pointer (message.h) refers to this structure.

files.purpose: Implements TLV nest walking, root cursor setup, cross-checking of cursors against the request index, and the exported ctlv_input_attr/ctlv_attr_* accessors used by generated readers. Callers are the CTLV_IN_* macros; the request validator (later) builds the index it consumes.

units.title: Header and includes
units.summary: License and includes for the message primitives.

units.title: ctlv_message_next()
units.summary: Advances to the next child attr of a nest, returning ATTR, END or BAD.
units.details:
- Starts at the first child or after the previous child's aligned length.
- Checks the remaining room, then the unaligned length, then the aligned length, so lengths never overflow past the nest.
- Used for walking untrusted nests while indexing.

units.title: ctlv_message_offset() and ctlv_message_root()
units.summary: Computes an attr's byte offset from the message root and initialises the root cursor of a message.
units.details: For a request with an index, the root cursor's nest scope starts at the first scope of nest 0 (the root nest).

units.title: ctlv_message_nest_index_ok()
units.summary: Verifies that a nest cursor agrees with the index entry its scope refers to (offset, tree, node).

units.title: Scope and ref consistency helpers
units.summary: Checks scope slot ranges against the index and resolves a generated input ref to its schema node, checking attr id and kind.
units.details: The refs come from generated code (CTLV_IN_REF), so mismatches indicate a core/generator inconsistency and are guarded with WARN_ON_ONCE.

units.title: ctlv_message_cursor_index()
units.summary: Looks up the index slot for a cursor and validates that cursor, scope, schema node and attr offset all agree.
units.details:
- Returns the slot even for an empty (attr NULL) cursor.
- For a positioned cursor, checks attr id, parent nest offset, and that the attr lies within the slot's offset range.
- For nest-kind nodes, checks the nested scope matches; otherwise requires no nested scope.
- Central guard used by ctlv_input_cursor, ctlv_attr_next, ctlv_attr_ok and payload access.

units.title: ctlv_message_input_rebind()
units.summary: Re-targets a nest cursor to another schema tree and node among the scopes indexed for the same nest instance.
units.details: Supports nests whose content is interpreted under a different schema node; returns false if no scope for that tree and node was indexed.

units.title: ctlv_input_attr()
units.summary: Positions a cursor on the first attr of a given slot within a nest, using the request index.
units.details:
- Always returns the cursor; on any failure it is left empty (attr NULL) so readers see 'absent'.
- On success it points at the slot's first_offset and carries the child node, depth and scope links.
- For nest children, also records the first nested scope.
- Called by the CTLV_IN_* macros and CTLV_IN_FOR_EACH.

units.title: ctlv_input_cursor()
units.summary: Checks that a cursor produced by iteration belongs to the slot named by a ref.
units.details: Used by the CTLV_IN_EACH_* getters before reading a value.

units.title: ctlv_attr_next()
units.summary: Advances an iteration cursor to the next repeated attr in the same slot, or empties it at the slot end.
units.details: For nest-kind attrs it follows the nest chain (`next`) to move the nested scope with the attr. The final cursor is re-validated.

units.title: ctlv_attr_ok()
units.summary: True if the cursor points at an attr and is consistent with the index; the loop condition for CTLV_IN_FOR_EACH.

units.title: Payload access helpers
units.summary: Return an attr's payload after confirming the schema node kind is one the reader accepts and, for fixed-size readers, that the length matches.
units.details: Kinds are passed as a BIT() mask. A length mismatch against a validated kind would be a core bug rather than a user error.

units.title: Typed attr readers
units.summary: Exported readers for u64 (uint, enum, flags), s64, bool, string and binary payloads, returning zero/NULL for absent or mismatched cursors.
units.details: ctlv_attr_string() requires a non-empty NUL-terminated payload; ctlv_attr_binary() always sets *len, to 0 on failure. All are in namespace CTLV.

units.title: Trailing comment
units.summary: Comment at the end of the file about measuring room before writing; its function arrives in a later patch.

files.purpose: Private representation of a message and its request index, plus the nest-walking interface; included by internal.h and the core .c files.

units.title: Header, includes and index sentinel
units.summary: Includes and the CTLV_MESSAGE_INPUT_INDEX_NONE sentinel meaning 'no scope/nest'.

units.title: Request index structures
units.summary: Slot, scope, nest and index structs forming a flat, offset-based index of a request's attrs.
units.details:
- slot: per schema child, the first/end offsets, count, first excess offset and nest chain.
- scope: one schema node interpretation of a nest and its range of slots.
- nest: one nest instance in the message, its scopes and next sibling.
- index: the three growable arrays with counts and capacities.

units.title: struct ctlv_msg
units.summary: A message buffer (request or output) with its root attr, length, schema tree, family, owning context, optional input index and poison error.

units.title: enum ctlv_message_step
units.summary: Result of one step of nest walking: ATTR, END, or BAD.

units.title: Message function prototypes
units.summary: Declares the walking, offset, root and rebind functions, and ctlv_message_index_free() (implemented in a later patch).

units.title: Payload inline helpers
units.summary: Payload length and pointer derived from the attr header.

files.purpose: Family-facing header; this patch adds the input reader API and the CTLV_IN_* macros that generated family code expands into typed getters over ctlv_input_ref.

units.title: Input accessor prototypes
units.summary: Declares the exported input functions implemented in drivers/ctlv/message.c.

units.title: CTLV_IN_REF
units.summary: Generates a `<name>_ref()` inline returning the constant ctlv_input_ref (tree, attr id, node, slot, kind) for one attr.

units.title: CTLV_IN_FOR_EACH
units.summary: Loop over every instance of a repeated attr in a nest using ctlv_input_attr, ctlv_attr_ok and ctlv_attr_next.

units.title: CTLV_IN_HAS
units.summary: Generates `<name>_present()`, true if the attr occurs in the nest.

units.title: Single-attr getter macros
units.summary: Generate `<name>_get()` for u64, s64, bool, string, binary and nest attrs, each locating the attr through its ref and delegating to ctlv_attr_*.
units.details: Absent attrs yield 0/false/NULL (and an empty nest cursor).

units.title: Iteration getter macros
units.summary: Generate `<name>_get()` readers for a cursor produced by CTLV_IN_FOR_EACH, first checking with ctlv_input_cursor that the cursor belongs to that attr.
